name: rdd-sender-firefox-extension
description: Firefox WebExtension for sending links to a Real-Debrid Downloader instance.

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files README.md package.json package-lock.json web-ext-artifacts
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest --ignore-files README.md package.json package-lock.json web-ext-artifacts
scripts.sign: web-ext sign --source-dir . --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --channel unlisted --ignore-files README.md package.json package-lock.json web-ext-artifacts
